title: Actual ordinary derived restriction for pulled-back condensed coefficients
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], and let $t:T_0\to T$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], in particular a closed immersion when applying the construction to a closed pair. Use the small pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Write $\Lambda_V=p_V^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], $\mathcal A_V=\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_V}$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], and let $t^*\dashv t_*$ be the canonical module pullback/pushforward adjunction [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. Write $\Gamma_V:\mathcal A_V\to\mathbf{Ab}$ for module global sections with the coefficient action forgotten [def-sfb-condensed-module-sections]. Define the underived natural section restriction $s_t:\Gamma_T\Rightarrow\Gamma_{T_0}\circ t^*$ by the adjunction unit $M\to t_*t^*M$, followed by the canonical restriction from sections of the pushforward over the terminal object of $T_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$ to sections over the terminal object of $(T_0)_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$. In the ordinary uncompleted derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with derived functors as in [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], define $\Phi_\Lambda(V)=R\Gamma_V$ and $\Psi_\Lambda(t)=R\Gamma_{T_0}\circ D(t^*)$, where the exact pullback acts termwise. Define $\rho_{\Lambda,t}:\Phi_\Lambda(T)\Rightarrow\Psi_\Lambda(t)$ to be the canonical universal right-derived descent of $s_t$ (the construction $\operatorname{rightDerivedPullback}(t^*,s_t)$). Thus its component at $K$ is the actual restriction $R\Gamma(T,K)\to R\Gamma(T_0,t^*K)$. This construction does not assume pullback preserves K-injectives: one resolves again after pullback. No product preservation, filtered continuity, or compatibility theorem is part of this definition.
